authority: PRODUCT_LAW -> docs/VISION.md -> Masterplan context -> tree census -> implementation
treeIdentityRule: treeID and branchId are semantic identities; coordinates do not define identity

configurationContract.facetRule: provider/application/service-runtime/model-variant/skills/tools/workstation/scope/permissions/approvals/limits/compliance/health are configuration facets mapped onto existing Seat branches, not a second Seat tree
configurationContract.agentCountRule: Agent count changes responsibility allocation and effective per-Seat skill bundles, not the common skill definitions
configurationContract.twoSeatRule: Fewer Seats may carry several Responsibility Units and broader resolved skill bundles
configurationContract.eightSeatRule: Up to eight Seats partition the same Responsibility Unit and common-skill substrate more finely; each Seat may resolve a different effective bundle
configurationContract.userSkillEditing: DEFINED_NOT_IMPLEMENTED; user-owned skill material must remain distinct from canonical TeamAi common skills
configurationContract.removeAgent: Seat lifecycle retire/remove operation; must not imply deletion of the user's root account
configurationContract.return: Cross-tree navigation to public Entrance; not a Seat child
configurationContract.dictionary: Complex Dictionary / User Guide (?) is a public guidance surface; not a Seat child

treeFamilies.allocationRule: Shared responsibility/skill definitions are allocated to participating Seats; do not fork definitions by Seat count

turnConfiguration.seatRelationship: Seat-local behavior may provide defaults/constraints, but global turn policy is not a Seat branch

settings.hierarchyRule: Settings is a navigation/control taxonomy and must reference the same semantic census identities; it is not a second machine hierarchy

dictionary.surface: Public Entrance Complex Dictionary / User Guide (?)

worldPopulation.durableSeatRule: A rendered slot is not a durable configured Seat; actual population is restored from authorized user/project state

branchContract.geometryRule: derive geometry from semantic/UI payload; never copy fixed prototype coordinates as universal truth

expansionContract.maximumHeroState: derived from combined active division footprints and payloads

turnLoop.signalModel: semantic electrical flow through actual connection graph

camera.current700msLerp: implementation baseline, not final travel language
